title: NuGet accepts packages without a valid signature
description: nuget.config declares a `signatureValidationMode` of `accept`, which does not require a signed package. An unsigned or tampered package restores exactly like a signed one, so the signature chain never gates the build.
remediation: Set the mode to `require` and trust the signers the project reviewed.
limitation: It matches a `signatureValidationMode` of `accept`, which does not require a signed package in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
